description: This Java class 'SamplingDataPrinter' is responsible for formatting and logging performance sampling data, including calculating statistical metrics like percentiles, median, and minimum durations, and outputting them in a structured log message.

classes.name: SamplingDataPrinter
classes.description: A Spring component class that formats and logs performance sampling data, including statistical analysis of timing durations.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Logs formatted sampling data for each class if data is available.

methods.name: getFormattedSamplingData
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with sampling data details for a specific class.

methods.name: getTimingsLog
methods.description: Generates a log string for all timing metrics.

methods.name: getSingleTimingLog
methods.description: Creates a log string for a single timing metric, including percentile, average, median, and minimum durations.
